panels.title: RULE-BASED ANOMALIES — WHAT / WHEN / MACHINE / EVIDENCE / SEVERITY
panels.description: Transparent rule-based observations only; not ML and not active-alarm lifecycle.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_status AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_id) equipment_id,event_time,event_type,event_message
  FROM public.machine_event WHERE message_type='status' ORDER BY equipment_id,event_time DESC,id DESC
), status_points AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,event_time,event_type,event_message,LEAD(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY event_time,id) AS next_time
  FROM public.machine_event WHERE message_type='status' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
), alarm_bursts AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes',event_time,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') AS bucket,COUNT(*) AS errors,MIN(event_code) AS example_code
  FROM public.machine_event WHERE message_type='alarm' AND level='E' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  GROUP BY equipment_id,bucket HAVING COUNT(*)>=${alarm_burst:raw}
), anomalies AS (
  SELECT 'CRITICAL'::TEXT AS severity,'Telemetry age exceeds setting'::TEXT AS anomaly,equipment_id,event_time AS detected_at,
    'Latest state='||event_type||'; age='||ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-event_time))/3600)::TEXT||'h' AS evidence,'>'||${stale_hours:raw}||' hours' AS threshold
  FROM latest_status WHERE NOW()-event_time>(${stale_hours:raw}||' hours')::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HIGH','Long observed STOP',equipment_id,event_time,
    'STOP duration='||ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time-event_time))/60)::TEXT||'m; '||COALESCE(event_message,''),'>'||${stop_minutes:raw}||' minutes'
  FROM status_points WHERE event_type='STOP' AND next_time IS NOT NULL AND next_time-event_time>(${stop_minutes:raw}||' minutes')::INTERVAL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'HIGH','Historical error burst',equipment_id,bucket,errors::TEXT||' level-E records in 5m; example='||COALESCE(example_code,''),'>='||${alarm_burst:raw}||' records / 5m' FROM alarm_bursts
  UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDIUM','Tool reached reported life',equipment_id,event_time,COALESCE(event_code,'')||' '||COALESCE(event_message,''),'event_code=0119'
    FROM public.machine_event WHERE event_code='0119' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDIUM','Decoder reported a problem',equipment_id,event_time,COALESCE(decode_status,'NULL')||': '||COALESCE(decode_error,''),'decode_status not successful'
    FROM public.machine_event WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND (decode_error IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(UPPER(decode_status),'') NOT IN ('SUCCESS','DECODED','OK','DECODED_MSGMANAGE'))
)
SELECT severity AS "Severity",anomaly AS "What",equipment_id AS "Machine",detected_at AS "When",evidence AS "Evidence",threshold AS "Rule"
FROM anomalies ORDER BY detected_at DESC,severity LIMIT 200
